name: Torvill & Dean: The Last Dance
overview: The one-hour special captures every moment of their farewell journey - from rehearsals and early training to their last performances at Wembley Arena.  The documentary offers a rare, behind-the-scenes look at their partnership, legacy, and emotional goodbye to fans.  Torvill and Dean said it will be filled with “poignant and joyful moments” as they skate together one last time.
